resources.string: Start on boot and battery optimization guidance
Feature visibility and default editor choices
Log details, file size and clearing logs
When disabled, the boot receiver will not start the runtime. Existing running services and other triggers are not switched off.
Open Android battery settings to review background restrictions. Device manufacturers may also have separate auto-start and power settings.
New feature configuration pages initially show advanced fields. Each page can still collapse them.
Include preinstalled/system apps when choosing an application. The app picker can still hide them temporarily.
Choose which new execution records are stored. Higher levels keep fewer events; errors are always retained.
Maximum size per log file. There can be one current file and one rotated file. Changes apply to new writes.
Clear in-memory and current/rotated execution logs. Does not delete saved automations.
Delete all stored execution logs? This cannot be undone.
